title: Class-wide injunctive or declaratory relief
summary: Rule 23(b)(2) concerns a defendant’s action or refusal to act on grounds generally applicable to a class, making appropriate class-wide injunctive or corresponding declaratory relief.
notes: The Court did not decide that every incidental monetary remedy is categorically excluded. Individualized damages can require the different safeguards of Rule 23(b)(3).

sections.Meaning: Rule 23(b)(2) concerns a defendant’s action or refusal to act on grounds generally applicable to a class, making appropriate class-wide injunctive or corresponding declaratory relief.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the conduct and the remedy, and explain whether the relief operates on the class as a whole. Wal-Mart examines why the individualized backpay claims there did not fit that category.
